traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Mind meets power. Forceful, penetrating communication; words that can heal or wound and tend to be remembered. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Persuasive depth and a talent for getting at hidden information. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize thinking and power into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what thinking and power have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Sales, persuasion, research, and anything requiring depth and force of message.
shadow: The ease lets scattered overthinking and control and obsession go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
base: One precise question can reveal more than another hour spent arguing with the surface version of a problem.

readerCopy.body: One precise question can reveal more than another hour spent arguing with the surface version of a problem. When Mercury sextiles Pluto, thought and depth cooperate, helping research and difficult conversations reach information with actual leverage behind it. A discrepancy, missing detail, or part of the story that never added up can become especially useful. The goal is not a total confession; it is enough truth to know what the next move should be.
